notes: The RTL drives sdi_dat_o directly from serial.sreg, so the received-payload walk also reaches that output even though C3 lists only bus_rsp_o.data as its exit port.
The FIFO instances are another IP, so payload propagation from their inputs to outputs is reported using the specified black-box assumption.
The conceptual assets describe bus response readback, but bus_rsp_o.data is a bus response record field and is barred from being a primary structural asset.
